12/13 tests passed. The one failure? A missing memo field on a DB insert.

In fintech, a 92% pass rate is a warning, not a win. One unhandled edge case in a payment reconciliation loop can quietly bleed trust and capital.

Takeaway: Ship fast, but verify the silent failures. The best engineers obsess over the 1 failing test, not the 12 passing.

Title: Why 12/13 Passing Tests is a FAILURE

[0-3s] Hook: "12 out of 13 tests passed. That's a failure."
[3-8s] Context: "A crypto payment listener was reconciling perfectly. But one DB insert was missing a charge_id memo."
[8-12s] Insight: "Silent failures don't crash your system. They just bleed money and trust until someone audits the database."
[12-15s] CTA: "Want to build resilient systems? Obsess over the 1 failing test, not the 12 passing ones."
